'''''Galium elongatum''''' ('''marsh bedstraw''' or '''tall bedstraw''') is a species of plants in the  [[Rubiaceae]]. It is widespread across most of [[Europe]], [[North Africa]] and the [[Middle East]] from [[Turkey]] to [[Palestine (region)|Palestine]] to [[Iran]].<ref name="kathywright">{{Cite web |title=Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/?name_id=86260 |access-date=2026-02-03 |website=Plants of the World Online |language=en}}</ref>

''Galium elongatum'' is a tall, erect herb with panicles of small white flowers.<ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=galium+elongatum Altervista Flora Italiana, Caglio tardivo]</ref><ref>Presl, Carl Bořivoj. 1822. Deliciae Pragenses, Historiam Naturalis Spectantes  119</ref>
